{{Quote|May it please the Senate, I have urgent business to place before this Senate immediately.''"<br />"''The chair recognizes the honorable Senator Suldar from B'nish.|[[Ivaar Workan|Kameron Suldar]] and [[Nensu Kaatik]], who allows the senator to move his hoverdais forward|<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
'''Repulsorpods''', also named '''hoverdaises''', '''Senate pods''', or '''viewing platforms''', were hovering balconies for members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Characteristics==
When a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] had the "floor", the pod would be detached from its docking place in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], and would take a position near the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]], so that Senator could be in full view of the other Senators.

==History==
[[File:DunMoch.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Sidious throwing repulsorpods at Yoda]]
Exactly when the repulsorpods were adopted is unknown, as Senators originally sat on marble benches in the [[Senate Hall]].<ref name="TOTJTSW3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 3]]</ref> A Repulsorpod&mdash;or referred to in this instance as a "repulsorlift-platform"&mdash;was noted when [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|representative]] [[Bron (Human)|Bron]] used one in [[Tecave City]] in defiance of local anti-technology laws.

[[File:Repplatform.jpg|thumb|right|Bron in Tecave City]]
During his [[Skirmish in the Senate|duel]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] hurled multiple repulsorpods at the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]], in the one of the most extreme uses of [[Dun Möch/Legends|Dun Möch]] ever recorded.

The [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] did not adopt the practice of repulsorpods right away, possibly feeling it was too associated with the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] adopted the old style marble benches used during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="TOTJTSW3" />

As membership in the New Republic grew, they converted to balconies, but these were not equipped with repulsors. There were rumors about adding them in under [[Borsk Fey'lya]]'s administration, but were not seen until several years after the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
The senatorial platforms were first seen in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. They were initially created as observation platforms to host the audience of the [[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta Eve]] [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|classic]], but had been attributed their final function as early as [[1997]], during the production of the movie.<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>
